fields.n: React dashboard redesign for SaaS ops team
fields.description: Need a designer-developer to refresh an internal ops dashboard: clearer hierarchy, denser tables, and a calmer color system.
fields.proposal: Hi — I ship product UI end-to-end. Happy to audit the current dashboard, propose a tighter information architecture, then implement the first two screens in React.

fields.description: Convert an approved Figma marketing page into a fast Next.js site with CMS-ready copy blocks.
